about: The Parkmed look as numbers, for the check (bun parkmed/check.ts). Colours, type and corners counted from the Parkmed APEX starter stylesheet (apex-build skill, __prefix__.css, recoloured to the Parkmed look on 12 Oct 2026) on 23 Nov 2026; spacing in multiples of 4 on GARO's scale, by the owner's decision of 23 Nov 2026. The starter's styles.css and instructions/rules.md carry the same numbers and the relations between parts: change all three together.

spacing.notes: Every padding and gap is a multiple of 4 (the owner, 23 Nov 2026: "Change the spacing themes to multiples of 4 for both parkmed like Garo"), on GARO's scale 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64 (GARO design.md section 2.3). Lines of 1 to 3 px are strokes, not spaces. The APEX stylesheets of the Parkmed apps still write 6, 10 and 14: a design and its built page differ there until a screen's spaces are moved, as GARO moves its older spaces when a screen is next changed. A fix snaps to the nearest snapTo step, the smaller one on a tie.

radius.notes: 4 x11 and 6 x10 in the stylesheet; every larger radius there is a pill (half the height or more), which the check accepts.

fontSizes.notes: The type scale is 24 / 18 / 16 / 14 / 12; 13, 11 and 20 are the stylesheet's detail sizes. Body text is 14, labels and table headers 12, the page title 24 (weight 600).

colors.notes: Green #55ae65 is for the wordmark only. Amber (warn) means due soon or below target; red (bad) only critical. A normal state has no colour. Teal is never used.
